I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message: "Thanks Ilse, noted: Osprey rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines, deadline 21 October (a week from today), nothing needed from me for now. Just ask if you'd like a reminder closer to the date."

Her message was only an update, so I didn't take any other action. The 21 October date is what she told me. #north-team has nothing else about Osprey, so I couldn't confirm it.
